mapping.summary: Health check of BC setup with 100+ checks, plus AI-assisted change requests and setup guide.
claims: Runs over 100 read-only setup checks per company or across all companies
Checks run in the background and each company gets a score
Each finding links to the page where it can be fixed
Checks cover system, setup, users and security, finance, sales and purchase, and inventory
Includes checks for Danish localization such as e-documents, digital bookkeeping and FIK payment details
AI chat assistant turns a described change into a design that is sent to the publisher as a change request
Generates a readable guide to the company's BC setup and installed extensions
Only metadata, counts and setup flags are sent to the AI, not record values
Health check is free; full app has a 30-day trial
Available in English and Danish for BC online
